place: A ranch near Santa Engracia, Tamaulipas
description: A young Nils has a premonition about his fishing guide's murder — his first brush with precognition, an ability he later chooses to shut off.
A family financial setback forces Nils to fund his own way through Duke, selling magazines at the football stadium to make ends meet.
Duke's swim team faces Navy at Annapolis — a humbling defeat Nils remembers with self-deprecating humor.
A Duke reunion stirs memories of Dr. Rhine's parapsychology research, tying back to Nils' own unexplained gifts.
Nils pitches the Monterrey Institute of Technology's board on founding a Teaching Improvement Center.
Nils test-fires long-range rifles at the Lander shooting range with his friend Wayne Olsen, ahead of the One-Shot competition.
Nils is made an honorary member of the Shoshone tribe by shaman Willie LeClair, given the name meaning 'man who cares for birds.'
The One-Shot Competition crowd gathers at the Million Dollar Cowboy Bar, and Nils first raises the idea of helping Mexico.
A five-day rafting trip through untouched Arctic wilderness, tracking caribou herds along the Ivishak River.
A floatplane lands beside Denali; the group rafts through dangerously swollen rapids fed by melting ice.
A casual swim across the Rio Grande turns Nils into an accidental 'wetback' — a story he tells with empathy for migrants.
An emergency landing and gunfire from the ground make the cartel crisis impossible to ignore.
Nils consults with the U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service on how to focus his efforts for Mexico's environment.
A failing ranch — larger than Liechtenstein — is turned into a model of conservation-based ecotourism.
Nils helps found a wildlife safari park, introducing city dwellers to conservation firsthand.
Flying to visit family in Sweden, Nils reflects on music, heritage, and his Viking roots.
A stopover at the site of the first Viking parliament, held at this tectonic rift in 920 AD.

chapter: The Seine / White Cliffs / Flanders Fields
place: Paris, the English Channel, and Normandy
description: Flying over Europe, Nils recalls an earlier visit to the D-Day beaches and war cemeteries of Normandy.
A Soviet delegate recognizes Nils' Viking bloodline by his jawline alone — a Cold War story about Vikings who once rowed the Volga to the Caspian Sea.
An annual duck hunt where host Herman Taylor deliberately pairs Canadian, American, and Mexican conservation leaders together, quietly building international consensus.
Armed criminals are found camping on Nils' property; he coordinates with the Mexican army to have them cleared out.
Nils flies supersonic aboard the Concorde and finds himself seated near Jimmy Stewart.

place: New York City (World Trade Center site)
description: Walking through Lower Manhattan with a newborn in a stroller, Nils recalls once meeting the Queen of Sweden.
A Duke fraternity reunion at Cape Cod Bay, where Nils tries — and struggles — to rally old friends around Mexico's cause.
Nils translates a lecture by the Norwegian explorer, learning that the Ra II raft may have landed at La Venta, Tabasco — evidence of transatlantic voyages long before Columbus.
An epilogue: the Mexico Nils dreamed of has recovered, and retirees and old friends return once more.
